title: Blended hydraulic cements
source: ASTM International · 125th Anniversary Case Study Compilation
description: Blended hydraulic cements combine Portland cement or clinker with constituents such as slag, pozzolan or limestone. The specification addresses composition and performance requirements for general and special applications.
discussion: Discuss cement selection, supplier documentation and the project-specific performance tests required before using a binder in a lightweight concrete mix.

title: Loadbearing concrete masonry units
source: ASTM International · 125th Anniversary Case Study Compilation
description: This specification covers machine-made, dry-cast concrete masonry in lightweight, medium-weight and normal-weight classes. Its requirements are specific to the materials and manufacturing process within its scope.
discussion: Confirm the applicable standard for your manufacturing process. CLC products should not be assumed to meet dry-cast masonry requirements simply because they have a similar appearance.

title: Precast concrete septic tanks
source: ASTM International · 125th Anniversary Case Study Compilation
description: This specification addresses precast concrete septic tanks and their manufacturing materials, including concrete constituents, reinforcement, placement and sealing. The case study considers standards in a specific precast application.
discussion: Discuss the difference between a septic-tank specification and the requirements applicable to building panels. Review product-specific design, testing and installation documentation.
